symbols.description: An experimental process that produces a value reasonably attributable to a quantitative property of a phenomenon, body, or substance.
symbols.name: Measurement

symbols.description: A value produced by a measurement and attributable to a quantitative property of a phenomenon, body, or substance.
symbols.name: Measurement value

symbols.description: A property of a phenomenon, body, or substance that can be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: Quantitative property

symbols.description: A kind of entity whose quantitative property can be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: Phenomenon

symbols.description: A kind of entity whose quantitative property can be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: Body

symbols.description: A kind of entity whose quantitative property can be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: Substance

symbols.description: The property that is the object of measurement.
symbols.name: Measurand

symbols.description: The numerical magnitude associated with a measurand and given meaning by a reference.
symbols.name: Numerical magnitude

symbols.description: A reference that gives meaning to the numerical magnitude of a measurand.
symbols.name: Reference

symbols.description: A basis used for direct or indirect comparison in measurement.
symbols.name: Standard

symbols.description: An example used to state the mass of a measurand as 1 kg.
symbols.name: International Prototype Kilogram

symbols.description: A certified standard given as an example for comparison in measurement.
symbols.name: 32768 Hz quartz crystal resonator

symbols.description: A primary standard given as an example, containing 1.079 micromole of methane per mole of air.
symbols.name: Primary gas mixture

symbols.description: A direct or indirect comparison with a standard involved in measurement.
symbols.name: Measurement comparison

symbols.description: An instrument with which the phenomenon, body, or substance of interest interacts and that is capable of producing an indication responsive to the property of interest.
symbols.name: Measuring instrument

symbols.description: An output produced by a measuring instrument that is responsive to the property of interest.
symbols.name: Indication

symbols.description: A condition or process through which a measuring instrument is related to a relevant standard so that its indications are meaningful in relation to that standard.
symbols.name: Calibration

symbols.description: A standard in relation to which indications from a calibrated instrument are meaningful.
symbols.name: Relevant standard

symbols.description: The result of a measurement with which measurement uncertainty is associated.
symbols.name: Measurement result

symbols.description: A non-negative parameter associated with a measurement result that characterizes the dispersion of values reasonably attributable to the measurand, based on the information used.
symbols.name: Measurement uncertainty

symbols.description: A quantity associated with a measurement result that characterizes dispersion of values attributable to the measurand.
symbols.name: Parameter

symbols.description: The spread or variability characterized by a measurement uncertainty or by an attribute of a probability distribution.
symbols.name: Dispersion

symbols.description: A value being attributed to a measurand.
symbols.name: Quantity value

symbols.description: Information on which the characterization of dispersion of quantity values attributed to a measurand is based.
symbols.name: Information used

symbols.description: A measurand whose property of interest can be quantified by a single real number.
symbols.name: Scalar measurand

symbols.description: A single number used to quantify a scalar measurand.
symbols.name: Real number

symbols.description: A parameter that may express measurement uncertainty for a scalar measurand and an attribute of a probability distribution representing its scatter.
symbols.name: Standard deviation

symbols.description: Measurement uncertainty expressed as a standard deviation.
symbols.name: Standard measurement uncertainty

symbols.description: A specified multiple of a standard deviation that may express measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: Specified multiple

symbols.description: An interval whose half-width may express measurement uncertainty when it includes the measurand with a stated coverage probability.
symbols.name: Interval

symbols.description: Half the width of an interval used as a possible expression of measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: Half-width

symbols.description: A stated probability that an interval includes the measurand.
symbols.name: Coverage probability

symbols.description: The state of knowledge about the measurand expressed by measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: Incomplete knowledge

symbols.description: A distribution over the set of possible values for a measurand used to represent the corresponding state of knowledge.
symbols.name: Probability distribution

symbols.description: The set of possible values for a measurand over which a probability distribution is defined.
symbols.name: Possible measurand values

symbols.description: The corresponding state of knowledge about a measurand represented by a probability distribution.
symbols.name: State of knowledge

symbols.description: An attribute of a probability distribution representing its spread over the range of possible values.
symbols.name: Scatter

symbols.description: The range over which the scatter of a probability distribution is represented.
symbols.name: Range of possible values
